profile.name: Vlad Gabriel Neculai
profile.tagline: I write clean, reliable software — and spend my weekends around modified cars. This one is mine.
about: I am a developer who likes clean, efficient code that solves real problems — and I am always looking for the next technology to take apart and learn.
I do my best work in a team: sharing ideas, keeping everyone aligned, and shipping on time. Away from the keyboard you will find me at car meets or driving my Mazda3.
